pages.text: $(bold)How to open it$()$(br2)The management panel is the interaction core of the mod.$(br2)Open the panel: By default, press V to open.
$(bold)The four sub-modes$()$(br2)Switch Modes: Press 1, 2, 3, 4 to switch sub-modes on the left:$(li)1→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_build_guide)《Build Mode》$(/l): Construct buildings

$(li)2→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_road_guide)《Road Mode》$(/l): Pave roads and shape terrain$(li)3→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_tasks_guide)《Task Hall》$(/l): Manage tasks and mage status$(li)4→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_settings_guide)《Settings》$(/l): Modify mod settings
Basic Operations:$(br2)Interaction: Aim at a mage or building to see a white bounding box. Right-click to open its details page.
